get.description: Same language, votedUp and literal q filters as reviews. All pages; maximum 5000 rows and 10 MiB, otherwise 422 without a partial download. UTF-8 BOM, CRLF records, quoted fields, spreadsheet formula prefixes escaped with an apostrophe. No AI results, author IDs or raw payloads. Import coverage may be partial.
